chunks: Humran asked Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:
about a man who struck a slave belonging to him, and he died from his beating. He said: "He must free a slave."

key_terms.مِنْ ضَرْبِهِ: as a result of his beating
key_terms.يُعْتِقُ رَقَبَةً: he must free a slave as expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man beats his slave and the slave dies from the beating?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man whose slave dies as a result of his beating. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام states that the expiation in this case is to free a slave, showing accountability for lethal harm done to one under a person's authority.
